notes: This contract records a portable C++ TCK check for the standard joined-federate MOM HLAreflectionsReceived value. It uses only official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, the standard MIM, HLAinteger32BE, HLAbyte, and the C++ standard library. The adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, and application class/member names. Three receive-order application updates produce three separately verified Reflect Attribute Values callbacks, including two updates to the same object; baseline-relative direct counts and the final HLAsetTiming periodic value must agree. Timestamped delivery, DDM, provider-specific headers, registries, and service-reporting extensions are outside this slice.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador joined-federate MOM value requests, object-class publication/subscription, object registration, receive-order attribute updates and HLAsetTiming control, with FederateAmbassador discovery/reflection callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador object-management, MOM, callback, and HLAinteger32BE declarations
